name: Uda
description: A hat maker from Selhoff who became a skaab sewer after werewolves destroyed her boutique.

timeline.summary: Uda relocates and takes up skaab sewing after werewolves destroy her shop.
timeline.quote: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

citation.text: Skaab Wrangler (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
